sourceTitle: Morning Sunshine Xocolate Smoothie with Xocai Healthy Chocolate Activ and Protein Bar
sourceText:
Morning Sunshine Xocolate Smoothie with Xocai Healthy Chocolate Activ and Protein Bar
By: Adam Paul Green
Published: Thursday, September 8, 2011 - 10:26am

Ingredients




1 bar 	Xocai Protein Bar, crumbled
1 tbsp 	Xocai Activ powder
1 tbsp 	Honey
1 tbsp 	Cinnamon
1 1/2cup 	Vanilla Rice Milk or Almond Milk or 1 cup milk and 2 oz. yogurt of choice
1 1/2 cup 	Fresh or frozen raspberries, blueberries, or other fruit
6 cube 	Ice
6 whole 	Coffee beans ((optional))

Preparation

1 Place all ingredients in blender an blend until smooth. 2 Serves 3

About

"Shake-up" your average morning protein shake with the delicious blend of Xocoalate and fruit!
